"""Posthoc selected-array diagnosis only;no new model or broad quality claim."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V171-matching-residual-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');prior=read(plan['prior_scores']['path']);design=read(plan['design']['path'])['observations'];metric=DetailMetrics(plan['metrics_sources'])
rows=[];sources=[]
for case in design:
 if case['id'] not in scores['native_predictions'] or case['kind']=='real':continue
 a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(case['parent']['path']);b=prior['native_predictions'][case['id']]['balanced-EMA'];assert ref(b['path'])==b;frozen=np.load(b['path'])
 variance=a['variance'].astype(np.float64).clip(0);global_variance=variance.mean((1,2,3),keepdims=True)
 local=np.repeat(np.repeat(variance.mean(1,keepdims=True),2,-1),2,-2)
 ratio=np.sqrt(np.divide(local,global_variance,out=np.zeros_like(local),where=global_variance>0)).clip(0,1).astype(np.float32)
 for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
  binding=scores['native_predictions'][case['id']][f'V171-{endpoint}-correction'];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;c=np.load(binding['path']);sources.append(dict(case=case['id'],endpoint=endpoint,correction=binding))
  centered=(c.astype(np.float64)-c.astype(np.float64).mean((-2,-1),keepdims=True)).astype(np.float32)
  variants={'V169':frozen,'V171':frozen+c,'remove-global-RGB-mean':frozen+centered,'attenuate-by-local-noise-RMS':frozen+c*ratio}
  for variant,value in variants.items():
   row=metric.measure(case,a,base,value);row.update(endpoint=endpoint,variant_name=variant,id=case['id']);rows.append(row)
  x,y,w,h=case['ROI_xywh'];sources[-1].update(ROI_xywh=case['ROI_xywh'],noise_ratio_ROI_mean=float(ratio[...,y:y+h,x:x+w].mean()),noise_ratio_global_mean=float(ratio.mean()),correction_global_RGB_mean_DN16=(c.astype(np.float64).mean((0,2,3))*65535).tolist(),correction_ROI_RGB_mean_DN16=(c[...,y:y+h,x:x+w].astype(np.float64).mean((0,2,3))*65535).tolist())
groups=defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:groups[r['endpoint'],r['kind'],r.get('present',r.get('variant',r.get('noise'))),r.get('cohort'),r['variant_name']].append(r)
summary=[]
for key,group in groups.items():
 endpoint,kind,condition,cohort,variant=key;r=dict(endpoint=endpoint,kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,variant=variant,cases=len(group))
 for field in group[0]:
  if field.endswith(('DN16','gain','error')) and all(isinstance(v.get(field),(float,int)) and not isinstance(v.get(field),bool) for v in group):r[field]=float(np.mean([v[field] for v in group]))
 summary.append(r)
for r in summary:
 if r['endpoint']=='EMA' and r['kind'] in ['mixed-quiet','mesh']:
  print(r['kind'],r['condition'],r['variant'],'quiet',r.get('quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),'DC',r.get('quiet_DC_RMS_DN16'),'mesh',r.get('template_gain'),'full',r.get('full_error_RMS_DN16'))
output=repo/'docs/results/v171-selected-native-scaling-diagnostic-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,dict(status='posthoc-selected-native-array-diagnostic-not-a-new-model-review',scores=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),sources=sources,rows=rows,summary=summary,selected_nonreal_cases=len({r['id'] for r in rows}),new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,new_saved_predictions=0,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope='Diagnostic on the preselected saved synthetic/photo/flat/quiet arrays only,after viewing V171. Two untuned transformations remove the new correction global RGB mean or attenuate it by min(1,local supplied noise RMS/global RMS),with a2x2 packed-cell conditioning map. Targets are used only for these measurements. No derived arrays are retained,no new image/model is published,and no full822-case or blind improvement claim is made. These selected observations can motivate a future independently declared full-cohort test.'))
